audit.whatIsWrong: ALL SEVEN chart rows disagree between the layers. Every phases[N].side reads 'Skill' while win[0..4] read 'Veigar' and win[5]/win[6] read 'Aurelion Sol'. The page renders a different answer to 'who wins Level 1' depending on which layer the reader looks at, for all seven stages.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches the content layer exactly (Veigar x5, then Aurelion Sol x2). The full layer's uniform 'Skill' is the template default, not a verdict — phases[5].why and phases[6].why already argue that Aurelion Sol owns those stages, and phases[0].why says outright that you are the weakest champion in the lane at level 1.
audit.corrected: Proposed as one atomic group: phases[0..4].side to 'Veigar', phases[5..6].side to 'Aurelion Sol'. phases[4].why also rewritten, because it argued for Aurelion Sol against a row that belongs to Veigar. phases[0..3].why describe your farming pattern rather than a verdict, so they sit correctly under a Veigar row unchanged.

audit.whatIsWrong: The one interaction that decides this lane was never written: Event Horizon stuns only what PASSES THROUGH the wall, and Aurelion Sol's Breath of Light and Astral Flight are both interruptible channels. So being inside the cage is survivable — crossing the edge, or flying out through it, is what kills you. The existing text half-says this ('only the cage EDGE stuns') but pairs it with 'never dash into the wall', and Aurelion Sol has no dash.
audit.why: Riot's E text: 'creates a cage that Stuns enemies that pass through.' ownerKit flags Q and W as 'interruptible — any CC cancels it'. Event Horizon is 20/18.5/17/15.5/14s at 725 range — the longest cooldown in his kit and the whole green light.
audit.corrected: Written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[1].d, tradeGood, tradeBad, report[5].t and early, with the real 20s-to-14s numbers and 'keep beaming rather than crossing it' as the actual instruction.

audit.whatIsWrong: The content layer is written for the pre-rework Aurelion Sol — 'Starsurge', 'stacked stars', 'slow orbit windup', 'Comet of Legend', 'Voice of Light star count' and 'movespeed/dash options' appear across whys[3], whys[6], spikes[0..3], early, mid and late. Aurelion Sol has no dash and no orbiting stars.
audit.why: Current kit: Breath of Light (750 beam), Astral Flight (1500 flight over terrain), the black hole (750 percent-health execute), Falling Star / The Skies Descend (1250), Stardust as the permanent passive.
audit.corrected: All rewritten in current-kit terms, with Astral Flight named as the tool that carries you clear of a forming Event Horizon.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[2] says Primordial Burst is an 'execute once you're below 40% HP', and whys[4], spikes[1].text and mid all call it an execute.
audit.why: Riot: 'Blasts target enemy champion, dealing a large amount of magic damage, increasing based on the target's missing health.' There is no threshold and no execute — it is a scaling nuke, and 40% is a magnitude with no source (defect catalogue item 6). It is also 120/90/60s at 650 range, dropping to 60 seconds while Falling Star only reaches 100.
audit.corrected: Restated as damage that grows with missing health, with the real cooldown curve in spikes[1].text and dontsFull[2].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed: dosFull[1].d is the tradeGood string under 'Hold R as the anti-dive stun post-6', dontsFull[2].d is the tradeBad string under 'Trade HP for stacks below half health'. dontsFull[0].d also calls a single male enemy 'they'.
audit.corrected: Both bodies rewritten to match their titles. dontsFull[0].d now carries the real reason eating poke is expensive here: Phenomenal Evil grants permanent AP every time a spell strikes you.

audit.why: 52.11% over 735 games; no elo split written anywhere.

audit.whatIsWrong: This audit moved phases[0..3].side from "Skill" to "Veigar" but left the four whys unchanged, so each of those level-chart rows displayed a Veigar verdict above prose still written as Aurelion Sol winning the stage. tools/regression-check.js flagged all four as regressions introduced by this audit.
audit.why: The content layer already said Veigar for rows 0-4 and its whys already described Veigar winning, so the sides were the correct half and the full-layer prose was the stale half. Veigar Baleful Strike is 1000 range on a 6s cooldown at rank 1 and converts kills into permanent AP; Event Horizon is 725 range and stuns on its edge; Aurelion Sol channels Breath of Light at 750. That range and scaling gap is why he owns levels 1-5.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].why rewritten to state Veigar winning each stage with the real ranges and cooldowns, so side and why now agree and match the content whys.

notes:
SEVEN-ROW CHART DISAGREEMENT — the worst one in my slice. Every phases[N].side on this matchup read 'Skill' while the content win[] row read Veigar x5 then Aurelion Sol x2, so all seven stages rendered two different answers. Proposed as one atomic group. phases[4].why was rewritten in the same proposal because it argued for Aurelion Sol under a Veigar row; phases[0..3].why describe your farming pattern rather than a verdict and read correctly under a Veigar row unchanged.

PACKET SUSPECT NAME IS A FALSE POSITIVE: 'His Event Horizon' in mid is the correct name for Veigar's E. The real defect in that sentence was 'Primordial Burst execute' (it is not an execute) and the pre-rework 'Comet of Legend and Voice of Light stars'.

KIT DATA ODDITY, NOT WRITTEN ANYWHERE: enemyKit lists Dark Matter (W) with cd '0'. Riot's text says 'Stacks of Phenomenal Evil reduce Dark Matter's cooldown', so the base value is simply missing from the extract rather than actually zero. I gave Dark Matter's range (950) and never quoted a cooldown for it.

KIT FLAG MISFIRE: ownerKit W (Astral Flight) carries terrain='creates terrain'. Riot says he flies OVER terrain. Same false flag on all six briefs I have read for this champion.

UNVERIFIED / LEFT ALONE: whether Event Horizon's wall stuns Aurelion Sol while he is mid-Astral-Flight (the ownerKit calls W an interruptible channel and Riot says the cage stuns 'enemies that pass through', but flight over the wall is not addressed). dontsFull[1].d is written as 'check Event Horizon before you commit the W', which is correct advice either way, but the underlying claim is Medium confidence. Also unverified: whether Falling Star's stun can interrupt Primordial Burst's cast.

Templated but left standing for lack of Veigar-specific grounding: breakdown.early, breakdown.mid, breakdown.wave, breakdown.spikes, breakdown.late, breakdown.difficulty, whys[0], whys[1], whys[2], whys[4], whys[5], wants.you[0..2] (all three are already accurate and Veigar-specific).
